description: SPT-3G, the third-generation camera of the 10 m South Pole Telescope, observing at 95, 150 and 220 GHz. The curves are the measured band-average bandpasses (Fourier transform spectrometer, 2019) released with the SPT-3G instrument paper, converted from frequency to wavelength.
facility_description: The South Pole Telescope (SPT) is a 10 m millimetre-wave telescope at the Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station.

links.label: SPT: Data for Sobrin et al. 2022 (instrument bandpasses)

licence.terms: No terms of use are stated on the data page; it says: "If you have any questions regarding this data set or its use please contact Joshua Sobrin (jsobrin_at_fnal.gov)."
licence.scope: Public data-release page of the SPT collaboration; no licence statement found. Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: 'Response-like' bandpasses including the etendue factor, 'Sky corrected (nu^4)', peak-normalised by the owner. Wavelength in Angstrom = c/nu of the tabulated GHz. DetectorType energy assumed.
